templates.name: Label Pill
templates.description: A small measurement or count riding on the footage: '930 · FEET'.

templates.name: Dual Labels
templates.description: Two boxed labels with a dotted connector for two things contrasted in one line.

templates.name: Kicker
templates.description: A short typed line in the top-left corner for a place and date said in passing.

templates.name: Kinetic Title
templates.description: A line rising word by word in condensed display caps with a kicker and an accent rule.

templates.name: Question
templates.description: The narration's question, typed and held.

templates.name: Word Type
templates.description: One or two words typed large in caps.

templates.name: Highlight Sentence
templates.description: The thesis of a section, words appearing left to right with the key words boxed.

templates.name: Key Phrase
templates.description: Only the important phrase of the line, bold, over the footage.

templates.name: Warning Strip
templates.description: A red strip with caps for an alert level or a dangerous state.

templates.name: Memo Box
templates.description: A typed memo box for a note-like line.

templates.name: Underline Title
templates.description: A title with an animated underline.

templates.name: Bar Title
templates.description: A title on a bar that slides in.

templates.name: Swoosh Title
templates.description: A title with a hand-drawn swoosh underline.

templates.name: Chapter (Ghost Word)
templates.description: A chapter title with a giant translucent word drifting behind it.

templates.name: Chapter (Editorial)
templates.description: A serif editorial chapter card.

templates.name: Title Card
templates.description: The plain bold title card.

templates.name: Banner
templates.description: A full-width banner headline.

templates.name: Breaking Headline
templates.description: A breaking-news style chyron.

templates.name: Lower Third (Tag)
templates.description: Name and role on a small tag.

templates.name: Lower Third (Line)
templates.description: Name over a thin line.

templates.name: Lower Third (Serif)
templates.description: A serif documentary lower third.

templates.name: Big Counter
templates.description: One large number counting up to the figure the line is about.

templates.name: Percentage
templates.description: A percentage with its animated bar and the noun it belongs to.

templates.name: Number Roll
templates.description: Digits rolling into place.

templates.name: Increase / Decrease
templates.description: A figure with an arrow for a rise or a fall: '↓ 12 FT'.

templates.name: Ring Stat
templates.description: A radial ring filling to a percentage, riding on the footage.

templates.name: Donut
templates.description: A donut chart of one share.

templates.name: Dot Grid
templates.description: A hundred dots filling to the share, the percentage beside them.

templates.name: Level Bar
templates.description: A wide bar filling to the share, the number riding its end.

templates.name: Stat Pill
templates.description: A glass pill low on the footage: the number, an accent rule, the words it counts.

templates.name: Number and Line
templates.description: The number on the left, what it counts in big type on the right.

templates.name: Progress Bar
templates.description: A bar filling to a level against its maximum.

templates.name: Bar Chart
templates.description: Two to five bars growing from zero, for values compared.

templates.name: Line Chart
templates.description: A line drawing point to point through the years, each value popping as the line passes, the last one rolling with the change in a pill.

templates.name: Area Chart
templates.description: The line chart with the area under it filled in the accent.

templates.name: Ranking
templates.description: Ranked rows sliding in: number, name, a bar growing to its value, the leader in the accent.

templates.name: Pictogram Counter
templates.description: Rows of pictograms, the counted share recoloured: 'N of M'.

templates.name: Scale Comparison
templates.description: Two or three quantities as circles drawn to scale, the ratio between them.

templates.name: Comparison
templates.description: Two labelled values side by side: '2020: 40%  2026: 26%'.

templates.name: Two Boxes
templates.description: Two dark boxes joined by a dashed line, a value in each.

templates.name: Split Screen
templates.description: Two visuals top and bottom.

templates.name: Timeline
templates.description: Nodes on a line drawing left to right, a label at each.

templates.name: Timeline (Ruler)
templates.description: A ruler-style timeline.

templates.name: Year Roll
templates.description: Years rolling to the one named.

templates.name: Span
templates.description: A span between two dates.

templates.name: Numbered Steps
templates.description: Numbered steps on a curve.

templates.name: Progress Steps
templates.description: Steps filling in order.

templates.name: Date Stamp
templates.description: A small date stamp in the corner.

templates.name: Date Card
templates.description: A full date card: 'SEPTEMBER 23 / 2026'.

templates.name: Age Tag
templates.description: An age or a count of years.

templates.name: Clock Badge
templates.description: A time of day badge.

templates.name: Location Zoom
templates.description: Zoom from space to the place, pin and label.

templates.name: Location Pulse
templates.description: Zoom to the place with an alert pulse.

templates.name: Disaster Map
templates.description: Night-graded satellite zoom for a disaster or a weather event.

templates.name: Tilted Landing
templates.description: The camera tilts into a 3D angle as it lands.

templates.name: Route (Satellite)
templates.description: Two places, a path drawn between them over satellite imagery.

templates.name: Route (Dark)
templates.description: A red arc drawing between two places on a near-black map.

templates.name: Route (Paper)
templates.description: A route on a paper map.

templates.name: Distance
templates.description: Two places and the straight-line distance between them.

templates.name: Region Highlight
templates.description: A state or country filled and labelled.

templates.name: Multi-Location
templates.description: Every named state or country lights up in turn.

templates.name: Multi-Location (Dark)
templates.description: The spread map on a dark base.

templates.name: Location with Inset
templates.description: Zoom with a small locator map in the corner.

templates.name: Marker
templates.description: A simple pin on a vector map.

templates.name: Paper Map
templates.description: A paper-look locator map.

templates.name: Dark Map
templates.description: A dark vector locator map.

templates.name: Arrow
templates.description: An arrow pointing at something on screen with a short label.

templates.name: Highlight Box
templates.description: A box drawn around the thing named.

templates.name: Icon Pop
templates.description: A pictogram that pops with its label.

templates.name: Bullets
templates.description: Three short points revealed one by one over the footage.

templates.name: Quote Card
templates.description: The quoted words with their speaker.

templates.name: Article Card
templates.description: A newspaper or report card with the key phrase highlighted.

templates.name: Paper Record
templates.description: A paper archival record.

templates.name: Framed Photo
templates.description: The photo drops in with a white border and a slight turn onto a blurred copy of itself, a typed caption below.

templates.name: Photo on Graph Paper
templates.description: The photo pinned on graph paper with a dashed outline and a typed caption.

templates.name: Place Photo
templates.description: The place's photo full frame, a location pin drops, the name and its coordinates slide up.

templates.name: Object Spotlight
templates.description: The photo of a thing floating on a dark spotlight, turning slowly, its name on a leader line.

templates.name: Photo Stack
templates.description: Up to three photos dropping onto a pile one after another.

templates.name: Person Card
templates.description: A round portrait on an accent disc slides in; the name in big condensed caps, the role in a tag.

templates.name: Water Tank
templates.description: A percentage as a tank of water filling to its level, the surface rippling, the number rolling beside it.

templates.name: Pie Slice
templates.description: A percentage as a pie: the slice sweeps round and eases out of the pie.

templates.name: Trend Line
templates.description: A rise or a fall: a trend line races across the frame, red down or green up, the amount rolling in a panel.

templates.name: Money Stack
templates.description: Money: bundles of bills drop onto stacks while the amount rolls beside them.

templates.name: Ruler Level
templates.description: A height or a depth on a ruler: the level falls or rises by the amount, the lost band hatched.

templates.name: People Ratio
templates.description: '1 in 4': a row of people pops in and the counted ones light up, the ratio rolling beneath.

templates.name: Shares Bar
templates.description: Parts of a whole: a 100% bar filling segment by segment, each share rolling above its part.

templates.name: Pie Chart
templates.description: Parts of a whole as a pie, slices sweeping in turn, the first easing out, a legend rolling beside it.

templates.name: Versus
templates.description: Two values on two panels sliding in from their sides, a VS badge popping between, the ratio beneath.

templates.name: Before and After
templates.description: The earlier value small above, an arrow drawing down, the new value big, the change in a pill.

templates.name: Tile Columns
templates.description: Two to four values as columns of tiles stacking up, the biggest in the accent.

templates.name: Bubbles to Scale
templates.description: Quantities as circles drawn to scale growing in turn, the ratio between them.

templates.name: Photo Window
templates.description: The photo in a floating viewer window on a flowing dotted desktop, its caption in an info window.

templates.name: Evidence Photo
templates.description: The photo full frame in black and white with grain, viewfinder brackets closing in, a small [ PHOTO ] tag.

templates.name: Photo Window on Footage
templates.description: A small photo window of the place or thing named, riding on the footage with its caption.

templates.name: Detective Board
templates.description: The photo pasted on paper, circled in red marker, an arrow to a handwritten note; two or three photos get hand-drawn links.

templates.name: Case Collage
templates.description: The story's own pictures bursting onto a red desk in photo windows, one after another.

templates.name: Recording
templates.description: A recording playing in an audio window: the waveform moving, the words appearing below, the speaker's photo beside it.

templates.name: Quote Callout
templates.description: The quoted words in a compact dark box near the top, word by word, the speaker under it.

templates.name: Report Window
templates.description: A report page in a document window on the desk, its key line marked with a highlighter.

templates.name: Newspaper Clipping
templates.description: A newspaper page landing on the desk: the headline, a black-and-white photo, the key sentence highlighted.

templates.name: Facts Card
templates.description: A portrait fading into the dark on the right, the points listed on the left under a heading.

templates.name: Dossier
templates.description: A file window on the red desk: the fields typed in beside a scanned photo, a stamp coming down.

templates.name: Source Tag
templates.description: A small outlined label low left on the footage: ARCHIVE FOOTAGE and its year.

templates.name: Location Focus
templates.description: A teal night-graded satellite zoom, a white box drawn round the place, its name in a pill beneath.

templates.name: Location with Photo
templates.description: Zoom to the place and pin it, then a framed photo of the place pops up on a leader line.

templates.name: Route Trace
templates.description: Two places on the teal satellite grade, a dashed cyan route between glowing dots, the miles in brackets.

imageTreatments.description: A slow push into the photograph.

imageTreatments.name: Pull Out
imageTreatments.description: A slow pull out from the detail.

imageTreatments.name: Pan Left
imageTreatments.description: A slow pan across the frame.

imageTreatments.name: Pan Right
imageTreatments.description: A slow pan across the frame.

imageTreatments.name: Archival
imageTreatments.description: Black-and-white grade, flicker and grain for material from the past.

imageTreatments.name: Vintage
imageTreatments.description: A warm faded grade with dust.

imageTreatments.name: Light Leak
imageTreatments.description: A push with a warm light leak sweeping once.

transitions.name: Slide
transitions.use: the next item in a list

transitions.name: Split Wipe
transitions.use: a section change, doors opening on a new place

transitions.use: into a chapter title, once a video
